The upstream README states that the collection of facts is in the public domain and, insofar as the curation qualifies for copyright, is released under the CC0 Public Domain Dedication. GitHub records the repository license as CC0-1.0. The legal text is in `LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt`.

These files are the catalog Talkfish ships. `openings/index.json` is built from them by `npm run openings:build`. Names and ECO codes are copied from this snapshot; they are not assigned by Talkfish.
